answer: Challenge-chain bond: an identity posts a 70-credit bond and files one key-signed opal link each epoch. Each link hashes the prior epoch's pulse reading under an onyx seal, so the chain grows forward only; a copied link breaks the hash. An auditor replays the chain; a skip, copy, or fork burns the bond. Forging 1,000 chains costs 3,037,000 plus 70,000 bonded for a 40,000 pool. Rented chains fail; one honest identity pays 40 once, keeps its bond.
